coinbase-blue.$description: Coinbase Blue — Primary CTAs, logos, active states — the core brand identifier.

interactive-blue.$description: Interactive Blue — Secondary links and interactive elements.

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Primary page background, text on dark surfaces.

midnight.$description: Midnight — Dark section backgrounds, primary text.

slate.$description: Slate — Body text, secondary headings, footer links.

ash.$description: Ash — Helper text, disabled states, subtle UI text.

frost.$description: Frost — Subtle light backgrounds, like the footer area.

cloud.$description: Cloud — Light background dividers or button hover states.

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Alternative dark section background surface.

positive-green.$description: Positive Green — Price increases, success messages.

negative-red.$description: Negative Red — Price decreases, error messages.

coinbasedisplay.$description: Used exclusively for large, impactful headlines (H1/H2). Its clean, slightly wide geometry gives headlines a declarative, confident presence.

coinbasesans.$description: The primary workhorse font for subheadings, buttons, and some body copy. The 600 weight is used for emphasis and smaller headings.

coinbasetext.$description: Optimized for readability in dense UI and long-form text blocks. Its generous line-height makes paragraphs breathable.
